pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: The dark regions exhibit complex, irregular, and stellate polygonal geometries with numerous angular vertices. Edge transitions display a high-contrast gradient, with some boundaries appearing sharp while others show slight micro-scale fuzziness. Patches are large in relative spatial area, dominating the visual field.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous topological network of light-colored interstitial space. The graph is characterized by frequent tri-valent and tetra-valent junction nodes. The pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform and narrow compared to the width of the dark patches, maintaining continuity throughout the visible flank and neck sections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck and shoulder presents a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated silhouette. The 1D geometric contour consists of a dense, upright, brush-like texture that creates a finely jagged boundary against the background vegetation.
